global_style: Elegant, minimalist template utilizing organic shapes, a Morandi color palette, and high-contrast typography for fashion or lifestyle presentations.

identity_anchors: Organic, overlapping amoeba-like background vector blobs.
Vertical tracking text aligned to the far left and right screen edges.
Prominent, oversized serif typography for numbers and section markers in slide corners.
High-contrast mix of classic serif headings with handwritten script accents.

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
